conf.description: F5 BIG-IP Application DoS log, CEF profile: anomaly envelope with cn3/cs4/cn1/cn2/cn4/cs1/cs2 Label-indirected resolution, its own mapping distinct from the attack-event dataset's reuse of the same slots

conf.comment: F5 BIG-IP Application DoS (Layer 7 DoS/DDoS) log, CEF profile. Shares the anomaly CEF envelope with the attack-event dataset (cn3/cs4/cn1/cn2/cs5 Label-indirected) plus its own cs2/cn4 slots. This CEF form is lossier than the semicolon key=value DoS log (dos_attack_name, dos_mitigation_action, dos_attack_tps, dos_baseline_tps have no CEF equivalent here), but the key=value form is out of scope for this work order - it is generated separately.

functions.description: why this pipeline is shaped this way
Split the CEF header into its 8 pipe-delimited fields; everything after the 7th pipe is the extension key=value string
Extract the space-delimited CEF extension dictionary (src, dst, csN/cnN and their csNLabel/cnNLabel pairs, etc.)
batch rename every status:mapped field with no transform

implement every partial/unmapped transform: cn3/cs4/cn1/cn2/cn4/cs1/cs2 resolved via their paired *Label (this dataset's own mapping, distinct from the attack-event and request-log reuse of the same slots), then drop intermediate parse artifacts
CEF rt is BIG-IP local time with no zone/offset (per-device tz unresolved - recorded as a gap); write to _time per platform constraint 1, never @timestamp
tag the dataset, hyphen-free per platform constraint 5
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
